reviews.title: Blocked access to my account and Funds after a bit win
reviews.text:
After a week of using the app , all of the sudden the access to my account and funds was blocked. I was told by customer support that my account was suspended due to identity verification. I just have two questions:
1- why you so concerned about identity verification only after your customers on winning streak and trying to make a big withdrawal? I find it a little bit strange. Identity verification should be done during the initial sign up process . I suspect you use identity verification as an excuse to block or delay your customers access to their funds , after a big win .
2- Even if the real intent  here is identity verification, I believe while identity verification process is still ongoing, customers should still be able to access and withdraw the portion of  their funds that’s been initially deposited from their own person bank accounts. It’s not a fair practice for you to hold the money that belongs to your customers. People have bills to pay.

reviews.title: Very Frustrating withdrawal
reviews.text:
I have legitimate winnings in my account, but I’m unable to withdraw them to my bank account. The app appears to offer the option to deposit or withdraw using your bank account number, but when you actually select it, the option doesn’t work.

I was also told I could withdraw to my debit card only if I had originally deposited with that card, but the app doesn’t allow me to make a deposit with my card either. The only option that currently works is Apple Pay. This leaves me with no practical way to withdraw my funds.

Support has been contacted; they couldn’t fix anything (one of them was very unprofessional) but the entire process has been extremely frustrating and complicated

reviews.title: Deceptive promos and terrible support
reviews.text:
I've been a high-volume bettor on the main FanDuel Sportsbook app for a long time, but this app is a massive rip-off. I opted into a promotion requiring a $25 trade and laid out over $25 of my own cash. Because the app secretly deducted a $1.10 exchange fee from my wager, the backend system recorded the bet as $24.75 and completely disqualified me from the promotion.

When I reached out to customer service to fix this petty technicality, the agent completely blew me off, hid behind standard automated scripts, and then literally closed the chat and walked away while I was mid-sentence. If you like hidden fee traps that void your promos and support staff that completely ghost you, this is the app for you. I'm taking my entire bankroll over to DraftKings and Fanatics where they actually value regular players. Avoid this trash.

reviews.title: They don’t pay out on promos they offer
reviews.text:

I did the online chat twice this week. First time was told it would take up to 72 hours to pay out. I waited for days, and chatted again. I was told it would be paid out, but they needed even more time.

I have also reached out via social media, and also emailed today, and am being ignored.
